payload.title: Add a small relation-retriever experiment and research open-source alternatives
payload.description: Extend existing alternatives task with user proposal: 10M/100M dense relation encoder, 100k/200k tokenizer variants, retrieval driven by user request and assistant reply, evaluated against large Markdown without DIP/model. Research primary-source pretrained/trainable open-source candidates and parameter/tokenizer tradeoffs. Produce a concrete shortlist and evaluation design; training/model comparisons remain future work.
acceptance: Update the existing alternatives backlog with custom small-encoder training, tokenizer ablations and query-only versus query-plus-assistant tests.
Verify candidate roles, model size/config and code/weight license sources; distinguish multilingual/Hebrew candidates from English-only and larger references.
Document fair large-corpus Markdown/DIP/model baselines, leakage controls, current-task retrieval and false-link metrics without claiming unmeasured superiority.
